segments.name: Wisconsin
segments.description: Regulated electric and natural gas utility operations of WE, WPS, WG, and UMERC serving customers in Wisconsin and Michigan's Upper Peninsula.
segments.evidence: The Wisconsin segment includes the electric and natural gas utility operations of WE, WPS, WG, and UMERC.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay regulated rates for retail electric, natural gas, and steam service, with wholesale and resale power sold in the MISO Energy Markets.
revenueModel.evidence: In 2025, retail revenues accounted for 92.3% of total electric operating revenues, wholesale revenues accounted for 1.9% of total electric operating revenues, and resale revenues accounted for 4.8% of total electric operating revenues.
